implemented_before_0_3_7: anti-loop recovery after repeated identical action
world pressure and timed world events
structured local Master memory in IndexedDB
memory ranks options but does not remove valid choices
P2P/WebRTC voice and host-authoritative shared state
applied_in_0_3_7: D20 outcomes now store critical, strong success, success, partial failure with progress, and hard failure using margin against DF; natural 20 is critical.
Generic and investigative failure narration/consequence now distinguishes near miss from hard failure.
Director state signature now counts world time, current objective, and world-event count, eliminating false stagnation when the world actually advanced.
Adaptive anti-loop recovery now consults valid actions in all three campaigns, not only Derenfall.
World events emit a visible omen one beat before escalation, when the characters could reasonably perceive warning signs.
Journal now shows separate objective-progress tracks in Derenfall, A Coroa de Vidro, and O Coro Abaixo, distinct from the pressure/threat meter.
State version advanced to 0.3.7 while old JS version remains preserved.

important_divergences_remaining.item: Current alpha is host-authoritative P2P, while the canonical production architecture calls for a server-authoritative Game Server + persistence.
All players receive the shared state; true GM-only rolls, private clues, per-character knowledge and secure fog-of-war cannot be trusted until state is filtered server-side.
Adaptive memory is local IndexedDB; central PostgreSQL schema exists but is not live.
No formal narrative Oracle service yet. This should be added only after authoritative state boundaries are enforced.
The alpha is investigation-heavy. Full combat economy, enemy morale, conditions, wounds/rest and tactical positioning remain thin.
NPC relationships and world beats exist, but reusable faction fronts/agendas/clocks are not yet first-class objects.
No automatic end-of-session summary/export of canonical state, unresolved threads and player-visible recap yet.
Map discovery is party-shared rather than individual/shared-selectable.

principles_not_to_copy_blindly: Do not turn every action into a roll.
Do not make every failure secretly succeed; failure may worsen position or produce defeat while the story continues.
Do not let random oracle output create canon facts that contradict stored state.
Do not let adaptive memory change rules, rolls, HP, inventory, canon or remove valid choices.
Do not expose hidden knowledge just to keep the story moving; move redundant clues through coherent channels instead.
Do not add a heavy point economy unless it creates a clear player decision that the current fiction-first model lacks.
next_priority: Server-authoritative room/game state with snapshots and idempotent event log.
Visibility scopes: public, party, player-private, Master-only for clues/rolls/events.
Formal world fronts/faction agendas with named progress/threat clocks.
Internal Oracle service constrained by canon/state and fully logged.
Combat/conditions/morale/rest expansion after state authority is stable.
